verdicts.reason: Both are unusable. The forest background was not stretched to the landscape canvas, so it fills only a narrow centre strip, and the white headline runs off it onto the white side areas, where it disappears ('Event Devo… ernational D… f Forests'). A also clips the subtitle ('…ration & Forest clea…') and leaves a stray divider line floating on the white area at the right. B is worse: it drops the subtitle, both rules and all the body copy, leaves an orphaned divider line at the top left, and puts the date on top of the busy treeline. So A keeps slightly more of the message.
